split: Existing independent Master6 actor game/terrain splits; exclude opponents whose name contains master3s2; reverify every public shard and source replay. The same old policy holdout is a development panel.
experiment: Two matched training arms. Both imitate the same real Master6 public actions and retain a KL anchor to the same frozen Sapling actor. Each gets a linear readout of 8 future economic labels: chronological 10/30-step gross original-actor and rival own delivery and tree income. Readout gradients enter the encoder in candidate only; equal-magnitude detached readout in control. Future outcomes never enter deployment features. A missed horizon is masked.
actor_loss: 0.8 actual action cross-entropy plus 0.2 original parent KL; role balanced. Each arm one identical permutation prefix of all eligible training rows. Evaluate fixed last update and int8 action outputs.
panels: On holdout require candidate standardized income smooth-L1 lower than detached control; candidate legal-action NLL at most control+0.01 and parent+0.005; at least 1% valid choices change vs parent. Evaluate all maps and both seats; report validation too. Passing permits a separate native comparison, never certifies wins.
formal: No new native maps used for this neural training or its diagnostic. Examiner steps/weights and every formal map stay excluded.
